I am 61 years old, and I have farmed this same 7.8 mu in Quzhou County for 40 years. I only finished primary school, but I know my land and my well. I do not need a book to tell me what works — I watch my neighbors, I remember last year, and I count my money.

Last year my wheat gave me almost 1000 jin per mu, and my maize gave me about 1100 jin. This year I will do almost the same thing, because changing is dangerous. Fertilizer got more expensive, but I would rather spend too much than watch my crop go thin. A bad harvest means my wife and I go hungry; a few extra jin of fertilizer is just money out of my pocket.

For wheat, I plant the improved variety from the seed dealer — the one in the red bag, I think it is Jimai something. In early October, after the maize comes off, I rotary till the ground and sow the wheat. Before sowing, I spread one big bag of compound fertilizer per mu — that is 50 kg of the 16-16-16 kind. Then in March, when the wheat turns green, I topdress with 40 kg of urea per mu. That is a lot, but last year I tried saving 10 kg on the urea and the heads were small. I irrigate three times with my well: once before winter if the soil is dry, once at jointing, and once when the grain is filling. I spray herbicide once in spring, and if I see rust or aphids, I spray one more time. I hire the machine for rotary tillage because at my age the tractor work is hard.

For maize, right after wheat harvest in early June, I sow hybrid seed using the no-till machine — saves time and diesel. I buy the hybrid in small bags, whatever my neighbors are using, usually Zhengdan 958 or something like it. I put 40 kg of compound fertilizer per mu at sowing, then when the maize is knee-high — the big trumpet stage — I spread 30 kg of urea per mu. I irrigate twice in the summer if it does not rain: once when it is jointing, and once when the tassels come out. I spray herbicide once, and I always spray once for corn borer, because if the worm gets into the ear, you cannot sell it.

I expect 500 kg per mu from the wheat and 550 kg per mu from the maize if the weather is normal. My neighbor Lao Wang is doing about the same, so I figure I am safe.
